name: _Send Payment Request
purpose: Builds and sends a QuickBooks Payments API request: reads the QBO config (sandbox flag, api key, company id, license) and base URL; for path "/tokens" goes straight to Intuit (sandbox or production payments host) with no Authorization header so card or bank details never reach the vendor's own server; for other paths prepends /quickbooks/v4/payments to the base URL with license, companyid and sandbox query values and x-apikey and Request-Id (UUID) headers; adds the JSON body and content type for POST; sends via "HTTP ( {request} )" and returns the response.
external: Perform Script HTTP ( {request} ) (LedgerLink scripts/78, step 56): HTTPS to https://sandbox.api.intuit.com/quickbooks/v4/payments/tokens, the production payments host, or the proxy base URL from "_OAuth BaseURL" + /quickbooks/v4/payments
open_question: secret: step 26 reads the payments apiKey (and step 28 the license) from "QBO Config" (script 63) and step 46 sends the key as header "x-apikey" with the license in the query; the target must keep these out of code. Step 22 exits with $error, which is never set (only $config is), so a config failure returns an empty result. The production tokens URL at step 35 reads "https://api.intuit.com.quickbooks/v4/payments" (".com.quickbooks" with a dot instead of ".com/quickbooks"), which is not a valid host, so production tokenisation would fail (sandbox is correct). Comment at step 8 "proxy2 replace" suggests the base URL is swapped for a proxy.

name: _btn: Cancel Credit Card Charge
purpose: Cancel button on the card charge window: clears the card fields, sets QBO::CardResult to "cancelled" and closes the window.
open_question: Result string "cancelled" is the protocol value read by the caller (not shown here).

purpose: Blanks the card entry globals in QBO (name, street address, city, region, postal code, amount, CVC, expiry month and year, card number) so card details do not stay in memory.
writes:
QBO::CardName#57 (Set Field step 1, global)
QBO::CardStreetAddress#58 (Set Field step 2, global)
QBO::CardCity#59 (Set Field step 3, global)
QBO::CardRegion#61 (Set Field step 4, global)
QBO::CardPostalCode#60 (Set Field step 5, global)
QBO::CardAmount#55 (Set Field step 7, global)
QBO::CardCVC#54 (Set Field step 8, global)
QBO::CardExpMonth#53 (Set Field step 9, global)
QBO::CardExpYear#52 (Set Field step 10, global)
QBO::CardNumber#51 (Set Field step 11, global)
open_question: Sensitive payment data (card number, CVC) is handled here; clearing these globals is a required PCI-style cleanup the target must reproduce (do not store card data).

name: _btn: Charge Card On Window
purpose: Charge button on the card window: closes the window, builds a charge JSON from the entered card (name, number, expiry, CVC, address) and amount, clears the card fields, calls "Charge Card ( {card, amount, currency} )" and stores the result in QBO::CardResult.
reads:
QBO::CardRegion#61
QBO::CardPostalCode#60
QBO::CardStreetAddress#58
QBO::CardExpYear#52
QBO::CardExpMonth#53
QBO::CardCVC#54
QBO::CardName#57
QBO::CardNumber#51
QBO::CardAmount#55
calls:
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/684 "_clear credit card fields" (step 8)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/682 "Charge Card ( {card, amount, currency} )" (step 10)
open_question: Sensitive payment data: card number and CVC are read from QBO globals (steps 5) and passed in a script parameter to script 682, which tokenises with Intuit (via 337). Step 4 maps "city" to QBO::CardRegion (the state), not CardCity, so the city sent is wrong. Currency is not set here. Card fields are cleared before the charge result is known (step 8), so a failed charge needs re-entry.

QBO::BankAccountAccountType#65
QBO::BankAccountPhone#66
QBO::BankAccountAccountNumber#64
QBO::BankAccountName#62
QBO::BankAccountRoutingNumber#63
QBO::BankAccountAmount#67
calls:
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/694 "_clear bank account fields" (step 15)
karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/691 "Debit Bank Account ( { bankaccount, amount, paymentMode})" (step 18)
open_question: Sensitive payment data: account and routing numbers are read from QBO globals and passed in a script parameter to script 691. Steps 8-10 swap in sample bank values when $debug is true; $debug is never set in this script, so it is dead unless a caller sets it. Steps 14 and 16 (a $debug wrapper around clearing) are disabled, so the fields are always cleared before the debit result is known. paymentMode WEB is hard-coded.
